items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: stay with Uncle T which was my grand-uncle, my grandmama’s brother

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you, before I forget, did you think it was really hip that your mother played with Dizzy Gillespie a couple of times?

Extremely hip. And she didn’t tell me that until I got older you know. I was probably about 40 when she told me that. But what had happened was she was in Harlem. She’d go up to Harlem during the summer and stay with Uncle T which was my grand-uncle, my grandmama’s brother, and work you know. But she would also go up there to go to Juilliard which I didn’t know. But she got into a summer program where she’d go to Juilliard and rehearse you know. Yeah, she had a friend from a talent show at the Apollo and so mama…
I like that term, “My mama made the gig.”
